sections.title: Special Events
items: Log in to GTA Online any time through October 28 to get the White & Red Tech Demon Mask.
This is week four of the Halloween event's free monthly items.
• October 29–November 4: Brown Vintage Skull Mask and the Halloween Chute Bag
Finish all three Short Trips before October 28 to earn GTA$500,000.
You start the Short Trips from the smoking lounge in your Agency, and you play them as Franklin and Lamar.
The cash is paid within 72 hours of finishing all three.
This week's challenge: complete every wave of a Survival to get the Gray Interloper Outfit and GTA$150,000.
Complete every Weekly Challenge through November 4 to earn a GTA$2,000,000 bonus. It is paid within 72 hours of completion.
• October 29–November 4: Complete 10 waves of a Survival without dying to get the Slasher Clown Outfit and GTA$250,000
